name: Grendel's Mother

crownPassive.name: The mere
crownPassive.text: Your heroes take 2 less damage from Ranged attacks.

bond.text: When a Grendel on your side dies, she gains +3 Attack and Speed 3 for the rest of the fight.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Drag under
actions.text: Attack an enemy hero in slot 2 or 3, ignoring cover.

rules: Grendel and Grendel's Mother are a pair: they are drawn together and must be fielded together.
